df_error_duplicate: A definition for this term already exists.
df_error_invalid: Please fill in both the term and its definition.
df_add_hint: The term is underlined wherever it appears in your content. Hovering (or tapping, on mobile) reveals the definition in a small popup.
df_field_definition_placeholder: Short explanation shown in the popup
df_field_variants_hint: Comma-separated. Plurals or related phrasing that should trigger the same definition (e.g. a plural form). Whichever form actually appears in the text is what gets underlined.

df_no_results: No definitions match this search or filter.
df_search_placeholder: Search by term, definition, or variant…

df_settings_skip_headings: Never underline terms in titles and headings (h1–h6)
